card.name: Linking words in farming and crop text
card.fires_on: Commas, small linking words and number gaps inside passages about farming, crop yields, fertilizers and pesticides. It fires on the word right before the next farming term.

modes.label: Linking words

card.plain: It marks the spot in a farming or crop passage where another farming word is likely to come next.
